description: Auto-bump pins so exact versions never rot: GitHub Actions (@v1 pins incl. semver-calver-release), the Gatus docker image pinned inside scripts/010-provision.sh, and the OpenTofu version pinned in .opentofu-version (both via regex custom managers). Minor/patch bumps automerge once CI is green; MAJOR bumps always land as PRs for human review. Requires: (1) the Renovate GitHub App installed on this repo, (2) post-bootstrap, renovate[bot] on the main-ruleset bypass list (its commits are unsigned).

customManagers.description: Gatus docker image pinned in the provisioning script

packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor and patch bumps (Gatus image, action pins, tofu patch) once CI is green
